commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "8b895546209d5d8025362aa6d120f8cc4b067744"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-trackpad-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npx vitest run src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts --repeat-each=5
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
